name: policy-1
change_reason: Initial decision policy from spec sections 13.1, 13.3, and 13.4.

hard_blockers.condition: A critical Issue consolidated TP in the baseline is consolidated FN in the candidate (reported apart from H1).
>= 2 Issues lower in a critical domain.
A candidate TP_FINDING fails confirmation (7.5) for an Issue whose baseline primary finding confirmed.
An invariant fails, or a manifest digest does not match.
The ground truth reached the harness (section 15).
CORE cannot complete because of the harness: suite budget exceeded, or the same harness crash in every replicate.
Runtime or cost above +200% and the benefit test (13.4) fails.
